about.body: The Tdi is Land Rover's 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel inline-four engine, produced from 1989 to 1998. It powered the Discovery 1 across its entire production run. The engine is an interference design — if the timing belt fails, pistons collide with valves, causing significant internal damage. Because of this, we replace the timing belt and tensioner as standard during every rebuild. The Tdi uses a mechanical VE injection pump, not a common-rail system. Rebuilds start from £1,900.

byModel.body: The Tdi was fitted exclusively to the Discovery 1 (L318) across the full 1989–1998 production run. It succeeded the earlier 200Tdi and was later replaced by the Td5.

compatibility.body: Because the Tdi spans both the 200Tdi and 300Tdi variants, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact vehicle's production year and specification. Earlier and later Tdi engines differ, and we always confirm your exact vehicle before quoting or supplying anything.
compatibility.boldNote: We always confirm by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.
